phase: 6 - first attempt to write to the phone's flash
result: NOT_ACHIEVED - three attempts, two root causes fixed, the third unverified

test_zone.why: the APFS container's own superblock declares block_count=608448, and the loader keeps the partition's last 8 MiB (2048 blocks) for its log, so nothing owns the blocks between
test_zone.state_before: all zeros in the 512 blocks backed up

failures.what: physio hands the strategy a user address
failures.detail: buf_map() returns bp->b_datap unchanged for a buffer without B_CLUSTER, and physio sets b_datap to uio_curriovbase(uio), a user address. Dereferencing it in the kernel is the data abort.
failures.how_found: two panics at a pc that resolved into loader_log's neighbourhood, with x0 holding a value shaped like a truncated user pointer
failures.fix: writes go through an ioctl with copyin(), never through physio

failures.what: my own poisoning took the storage path down
failures.detail: VRQ_NO_LEASE returns without reaching clean, so restored is false even though no command was issued. The driver treated that as 'issued and failed to restore' and called us_poison(), after which the loader guard refused to take ownership back -- no HLOG, no Android IO, manual fastboot.
failures.how_found: the panic text on the phone's screen was the exact string I added
failures.fix: a refused write returns the lease and is not poisoned

failures.detail: struct xnusys_write_arg is 32 bytes after alignment (uint64_t, uint64_t, pointer, uint32_t, uint32_t); the user side computed 24, so _IOW encoded a length the kernel never matched

also_fixed.platform.data_bytes: bounds every DATA-region access; the write path narrowed it without restoring, which made later two-block reads address past the mapping. Now saved and put back.

test_zone_untouched.how: after restoring stock, blocks 608448..608959 read back byte-identical to the backup, and so did the container tail
test_zone_untouched.conclusion: no write ever reached the flash

risk_statement: two of the three rounds left the phone needing a manual fastboot. Until the lease and poison semantics are settled, further write images should not be flashed.
